wps.title: Engine execution order (Simulink sorted order): non-direct-feedthrough blocks are sources; edges out of them are kept, edges into them ignored; per-block directFeedthrough flag

findings.summary: Pre-existing engine bug confirmed by Opus: XbridgesEngine.compile ignores edges OUT of stateful blocks and counts edges INTO them, so consumers of an Integrator run before it and read the previous stage's output. RK4 on x'=-x, h=0.1: one step gives 0.9025 instead of the RK4 value 0.9048375 (2.6 % error after 10 steps: first-order behaviour). Affects every X-Bridges simulation and solver.
Measured before fix: every fixed-step solver converges with order 1 on x'=-x (error ratio ~2 for ode2/3/4/5); ode45 misses 1e-6 by 75x; ordering depends on block insertion order.

wps.review: Opus 2026-10-20: convergence ratios after fix ode2 4.08, ode3 8.33, ode4 16.68, ode5 39.1; no legacy test changed or broken by the new order. src/help/helpCoverage.test.ts 'requires fresh live UI evidence...' fails identically on baseline 49f07cf (pre-existing, unrelated: stale live-UI report).

wps.title: Per-output feedthrough: outputs that depend only on state break loops (Simulink port-level direct feedthrough); non-converged algebraic loops must raise an error instead of returning wrong values

findings.summary: Found in EC-07: block-level feedthrough makes stateful PT blocks (manifold, turbo, dyno) form false algebraic loops; Gauss-Seidel did not settle in 5 passes and Newton returned wrong values silently (charge pipe 0.7 kg/s). Workaround in examples/ciTestCell.ts: one-step Memory blocks.

wps.review: Opus 2026-10-20: Gauss-Seidel up to 50 passes (test cell needs 2-9), Newton restarts from pre-sweep values and rejects singular steps, final residual check -> ALGEBRAIC_LOOP_NOT_CONVERGED error. Test cell runs without delay blocks within 3 % of the delayed build.
